scenario.name: r-cd-in-1-typed-input-snapshot
scenario.description: Typed continue_delegate({attachments}) input snapshot: staged snapshot receipt on the parent, workspace-relative mount provenance in the child, and no attachment content on the wire.
scenario.notes: Only the typed tool carries attachment blobs; the bracket [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: ...]] form cannot, so the both-forms mandate is not applicable to this row.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted (agent turn triggered for typed continue_delegate with attachments)

expectedReceipts.name: typed-tool-record-observed
expectedReceipts.description: Structured continue_delegate tool record observed on the wire, so the typed call is not credited from model prose alone

expectedReceipts.name: input-snapshot-staged
expectedReceipts.description: CDIN1-SNAPSHOT-STAGED sentinel carrying the tool-result attachment count and byte total (never the content)

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-bound
expectedReceipts.description: A structured record binds a child session key to this row nonce (row-child-correlation authority)

expectedReceipts.name: child-mount-provenance
expectedReceipts.description: CDIN1-CHILD-SAW sentinel naming the workspace-relative mount path the child received

expectedReceipts.name: child-bytes-bound-to-canary
expectedReceipts.description: The byte length and sha256 prefix the child reports for its mounted file equal the canary digest the harness staged: the mount path is bound to known bytes, not asserted

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-attachment-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: attachment content absent from every non-harness frame

expectedReceipts.name: no-absolute-path-mount
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: the reported mount path is workspace-relative

expectedReceipts.name: child-bytes-match-the-known-canary
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: a child-reported digest/size that differs from the staged canary breaks the row

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for Tempo fetch when the dispatch response carries one

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when dispatch is accepted, a structured continue_delegate record is observed, the staged-snapshot receipt fires, a child session is bound to the row nonce, and the child reports a workspace-relative mount path whose bytes and sha256 prefix equal the canary the harness staged. Any missing receipt or broken negative is PARTIAL-candidate.

liveRunSafety.notes: Spawns one delegate child with an inline attachment. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Serialize per session. Public-safe: the harness records a byte count and a truncated sha256 digest of the canary, never the canary content.
